summary: Aveanna Healthcare Holdings filed an 8-K announcing a repricing amendment to its First Lien Credit Agreement. The amendment reduced applicable interest rate margins by 0.50% and refinanced $1,318,375,000 of term loans and a $250,000,000 revolving credit facility. The new term loans and revolver bear interest at SOFR plus 3.25% (or base rate plus 2.25%), with a further 0.25% reduction upon achieving certain credit ratings. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is purely a liability management repricing, improving cash flow without equity changes. Watch for potential future leveraged actions or refinancing catalysts.
